description: Current-layout comments from S4 run 4 structural aggregates, invented values only: every post text row has one non-reference placeholder; uri="" is an assumption because S4 measured only neither link nor path, not emptiness. Media-only rows use invented example-domain HTTPS GIF links, plus one non-reference placeholder that stays importable with mediaCount 0. Same-second ordinal IDs, split overlap with a renamed URI, unknown-label placeholder text, one contentless rejected row and one unknown-owner usable-media rejection remain covered. D37 counts only usable references; expected counts are explicitly authored from invented data, never parsed. No entry has creation_timestamp. URI values never enter expected items; public field-name sources are in spikes/s4-real-exports/schema.ts.
